metadata.title: Budget Planning | AdonERP
metadata.description: A complete budget management platform — version control, departmental requisitions, multi-stage approvals, variance tracking, and formal re-budget requests.

hero.title: Budget planning.
hero.description: Adon Planning gives finance teams a single place to build budgets, track requisitions, enforce multi-stage approvals, and stay on top of variance — all with full version control.

dashboard.title: Budget Management
dashboard.subtitle: Version control · departmental requisitions · multi-stage approval · variance & enforcement

budgetTabsSection.title: Budget
budgetTabsSection.description: Plan budgets, track requisitions, and stay ahead of variance with a full approval workflow and a rolling budget review and forecast that keeps every stakeholder aligned.

lineSection.title: Budget
lineSection.description: Break every budget version into clean, categorized lines — track budget vs actual per line, assign it to a month, and edit or remove lines as plans evolve.

varianceSection.title: Budget vs
varianceSection.description: See exactly where spend is diverging from plan. Every category rolls up into a clear budget vs actual chart and table, with variance and utilisation calculated automatically.

approvalSection.title: Multi-stage
approvalSection.description: Every budget version moves through a clear approval chain — Finance, Compliance, Management, and CEO — with a full decision log so nothing gets approved in the dark.

rbrfSection.title: Formal
rbrfSection.description: Need to revise a budget line mid-cycle? Raise a formal Re-Budget Request (RBRF) — propose a new amount with justification and impact assessment, and let the approval chain review it before the line is revised.

features.title: Version control
features.description: Keep every budget version — draft, submitted, approved — with a full history you can always open again.

features.title: Departmental requisitions
features.description: Let departments raise and track their own requisitions against the active budget version.

features.title: Variance tracking
features.description: Compare budget vs actual by category and catch overruns before they become a problem.

features.title: Re-budget requests
features.description: Formally propose, justify, and approve changes to budget lines mid-cycle with RBRF.
